cost_decision.limits: Conservative whole baseline/candidate startup, whole native source guards/behavior checks, subsequent exact published-checkpoint native validation, and whole shared negative origin fixture charged to each application. cost_decision.accounting_note: The gross adoption screen above deliberately charges both observed startup paths and whole validation phases. The first-use difference is also reported; it is not the complete seed refresh/validation/transfer cost. Neither figure alone establishes the expected checkpoint workflow or final producer rollout cost.
